project.name: The Bellkeeper’s Last Post
project.author: A trail keeper
project.intro: Rook: “The return crossing opens only when the bellkeeper comes around.” Restore seven parts. Three jade letters pass through violet lockers, but Sprout’s eastern return bridge waits for Pip’s four-beat amber bell. A late ring can change a whole lap. Finish every relay, empty the lockers and return both hats.
project.ending: Rook accepts the third letter after the long eastern wait. The last bell fades; the post office has kept every promise.
project.source: Remix of The Bellkeeper’s Last Post by Lantern Trails

project.name: The Three-Beat Council
project.author: A trail keeper
project.intro: Eid: “Three one-beat bells. Two blue letters. One patient duet.” Restore eight parts. Amber, jade and violet open three separate crossings. Sprout will sometimes wait for another ringing cycle; a blocked move still advances a card. Fill both blue letters, bring both hats home, and leave every bell silent.
project.ending: Eid closes the council with a moment of silence. Three bells, two friends, and a collection of roads waiting for their next keeper.
project.source: Remix of The Three-Beat Council by Lantern Trails

blueprints.name: Parcel atelier
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: Put a courier two tiles before Q. East / East / Use collects, converts and delivers. Choose different input and output parcels.

blueprints.name: A sign with two roads
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: Use on Z chooses its next route. The northern glass returns the courier; the other bank opens the road to the right. Add your own wells and windows.

blueprints.name: A little brass shortcut
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: Use on either U travels to the other end of its colour. Keep one complete pair per tube colour.

blueprints.name: A bridge for a friend
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: One partner holds P while the other crosses B. The plate and bridge share a numbered colour.

blueprints.name: Letters across the water
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: K sends at one end and collects at the other. Its numbered colour names the connection; any parcel can travel. One parcel fits in each channel.

blueprints.name: A compass for your pockets
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: Use C with a matching parcel to go east. Otherwise return west. The northern and western mirrors make a little road for experiments.

blueprints.name: The midnight dyehouse
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: Use two tiles before Q. Collect, convert and send through K. Place a matching collect locker on your partner’s road.

blueprints.name: The patient collector
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: A collect locker and cargo compass wait for a parcel. Mirrors return empty hands. Add a window two tiles east of C.

blueprints.name: A bell that waits
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: Put Sprout on C with Wait / Wait / Use, and a handoff beside it. Empty hands keep waiting; a parcel chooses North / North / Use, delivers at N and returns by the northern mirror.

blueprints.name: A bridge that remembers
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: Use L to toggle its numbered colour. Matching bridges open next tick and stay powered after a courier leaves. Use any matching L again to switch that channel off.

blueprints.name: A fork beneath a lantern
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: Light the left L, then visit M to take its northern route. Another courier can switch L off while the first travels. M reads remembered power on its next Use.

blueprints.name: A bridge on borrowed beats
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: Use A to ring its numbered channel for one to six following ticks. Cross B before the countdown ends. Occupied bridges stay safe until the courier leaves.

blueprints.name: The bellkeeper’s fork
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: Ring A, then Use M while that channel is ringing to take the northern route. Quiet and Powered choose different roads. Configure the duration to fit your cards.

blueprints.name: The corner atelier
blueprints.author: Lantern Trails
blueprints.note: A well, recipe and clockwise corner lead to a window below. Begin two tiles west of Q with East / East / Use. Change the colours and delivery target to fit your tower.

assembly.name: Our little adventure collection
assembly.author: A trail keeper
assembly.intro: Choose a chapter and make a road together.
